scope: P2 post-restructure static affected-L2 layout verification only; it does not claim an L2 browser run or close any RM2 legacy test debt.

preReceipt.assertion: P0 established the RM1 production gate with the exact 18 pre-existing targets deferred to RM2.

postReceipt.assertion: The post-restructure registry derives each carry-over layout path from the current frontend tree; the RM1 production gate passes while preserving the exact deferred set.

boundary: A changed-surface invocation intentionally remains red for a deferred target. P2 is a behavior-neutral relocation and validates the required post-restructure layout with the normal RM1 production invocation; a future behavioral change on this deferred surface remains blocked until RM2 supplies its real L2 target.
